item.title: Documentation
item.description:
Workflow

The CHIPS database is a key component of a broader workflow integrating web-oriented technologies, including an API, a Python dashboard, and an R package hosted on GitHub.

item.title: State of interest
item.description:
why CHIPS DB?

Despite a broad consensus in favour of a global, shared repository for chemical data associated with ironworking, iron mining, smelting, and smithing activities, no initiative to establish such a global reference source had been undertaken in the field of iron archaeometallurgy research until now. The aim of the CHIPS project and database is to provide this information in a standardised and interoperable manner to anyone interested in ancient ironworking and, as such, it complies with the CNRS Open Science policies1 and the FAIR principles.2
